method.method_draft: First read the diagram as a 6-by-3 block rectangle, so the outside perimeter is 2(6+3)=18 block-lengths. The start point is at the midpoint of the bottom side, 3 blocks from A and 3 blocks from E. The arrows show Jane goes left from the start and Hector goes right from the start. From the text, Jane walks twice as fast as Hector. Since they walk in opposite directions around one closed perimeter, when they first meet their traveled distances add to 18 and are in the ratio Jane:Hector = 2:1. Thus Hector travels 18/3=6 blocks and Jane travels 12 blocks. Tracing Hector 6 blocks from the start to the right gives 3 blocks to E and 3 more blocks up to D, so the meeting point is at D.
